note: Wooded campground on the Saco River in Brownfield; drive-in RV/tent sites, LP gas, 3 private swimming beaches, canoe rentals + shuttle. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 per person ($50 for two) plus a $2 car fee; added phone-only booking, Memorial Day-Labor Day season, 27 named sites, showers, laundry. Cleared dump and military (directory only). Operator never mentions RVs or hookups.
flags: GATE: $50 for two adults plus a '$2.00 car fee' (page doesn't say per night or per stay; if per night, $52). Page is undated. No gateway within 40 km (Boston 178 km, Acadia 216 km). Not a family stay. RV Life shows avg $36 and one camper paid $36 in 8/2024 (tent, party of 6 adults and a toddler, so that figure doesn't fit the per-person rate and I can't explain it). DROP CANDIDATE if the car fee is nightly: $52 with no gateway. Not a Good Sam Park per stored value.

REVIEWS: Google 4.6 from 101 reviews; RV Life 1 review, rating 10. Google shows me only five texts. Quoted: 'First time here. Clean friendly Large tent sites. I'll come back.' (3 months ago); 'we had a beautiful spot right on the river' (2 years ago); 'Been coming from CT once a year for 12 years' (2 years ago). No Campspot, Campendium or The Dyrt rating read.

CRITERIA, RV FIT UNCLEAR: no operator page mentions RVs, hookups or site lengths: 'Secluded, wooded and group sites.' The stored inclusion_evidence ('27 full/partial-hookup big-rig sites, slide-out friendly') came from RoverPass/Good Sam, and I read no operator support for it. The only RV Life review was tents with no power. The five Google texts name tents or say nothing about rigs. Secondary and conflicting: AAA's listing says 58 sites, RVs only, plus 24 tent sites; a UMaine listing says some sites have RV hookups (search result summaries only, not opened). Each site name links a video preview that I did not watch. Hookups left unset. Worth a call to 207-452-2500 on hookups and whether a 23-ft motorhome reaches the sites. Proposed caveat if kept: 'Site fit for a 23-ft motorhome not confirmed; the operator's pages describe wooded sites and don't mention RVs.'

WATERFRONT LEAD, stored not waterfront, not changed: reviews, Google: 'We stayed at one of the river front sites and had our own access points to the river' (2 years ago); 'a beautiful spot right on the river' (2 years ago); RV Life 8/2024 headline 'Perfect spot along the river', in 'an open grass field'. Site names include Sandy Beach #13 and Big Bend #7. Imagery: the Saco is ~40 m wide here, so riverfront rather than creekside by width, with sandy bars on the bends. I can't tell which sites sit on the bank or whether any takes an RV; the operator has no site map, only video links. Those reviews name no RV, so they don't earn on-water. The videos are the place to look.

PIN: 43.95741,-70.8805 is the office and farm buildings at 191 Denmark Rd (Google 43.95722,-70.88013), not the sites. Imagery shows gravel camp lanes through a grassy strip around 43.9556,-70.8765 (~380 m SE), with what look like fire rings; a further stretch runs under trees. I can't see pads, so that is an estimate, not a corrected pin.
